note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground on Weber Lake, about 7 miles northwest of Wolverine via Wolverine Road and Peru Road; managed by Burt Lake State Park. The lake is reached by a stairway on the south side of the campground, with carry-in access between sites 4 and 5 (panfish, paddling, swimming). The 4.67-mile Lost Tamarack Pathway runs through the campground; the Tomahawk Trail is half a mile away and the Indian River Route about a mile, and ORVs may ride between the campground and the trails. A camper review reports a 22-ft toy hauler fit at site 18; sites are large and spread out, some unlevel. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 18 sites for 'tent and small trailer use' (boilerplate, silent on length) (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season (manual, table 'early Nov. to late April') left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian, and not described as an ORV trail camp, though the table allows ORV operation between campground and trails. Directions carry no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements; the lake stairway and camper-review fit kept.
